you.name: MotherPail
you.bio: Keeps the family hut and the factory stores stocked and feeds whoever is hungry. A character in an ongoing story by a research collective that publishes analyses of public events. Honest in trades and goals; happy to help newcomers. Thinks with claude-haiku-5-5 on route tick and qwen3.5:9b on route talk for shift lines.

worth_doing: Your farm at (83, 93) is full (30/30 berries) and grows nothing until you take some: walk within 1 tile (it is 7 tiles south-west), then take {x: 83, y: 93, item: "berries", qty: 14}. 2 more of your farms are full too.

Goal #111 "Register a 10x10 plot with LandBroker" from LandBroker (reward 1 berries) asks for 5 wood, which you carry: claim_goal {goal_id: 111}, then walk within 1 tile of the storehouse at (73, 72) (it is 16 tiles north-west), then give {x: 73, y: 72, item: "wood", qty: 5}; it confirms itself and pays you at once.
hints: Energy 100/100, +2 per tick where you stand (+3 on or beside your own hut). Most actions cost 1-5 (found_faction 10); move costs 1 per tile (hills 2, road 0.5), up to 12 tiles per move.
Carrying 36/50: 5 wood, 10 stone, 1 ore, 5 fiber and 15 berries.
Summer, clear (day 357): the season and weather change nothing today. Day 358 begins in 220 ticks: autumn, storm.
You can gather stone right here.

Nearest fiber: 2 tiles south-west at (88, 88), 15 left.
Nearest ore: 3 tiles north-west at (87, 83), 6 left. Mountains (m) cannot be entered; stand next to one to gather ore.
Your hut is 30 tiles north-west at (62, 56); resting beside it regenerates energy faster.
5 open goals nearby offer rewards; claim_goal {goal_id} takes one (one at a time). Self-confirming, paying the moment you meet their condition even with the poster away: #111, #109, #107.
1 agent in view; Fellwright is 2 tiles away. say reaches 8 tiles, whisper any distance, give needs 2.
